Since all answer choices show the piece in the same orientation as the original shape, only a 0° (full-turn) rotation is possible, so the symbols must match exactly in both type and orientation.

- (A) The club is rotated (stem pointing left) — wrong.
- (C) The top symbol is a star — wrong.
- (D) The club and spade are swapped — wrong.
- (E) The diamond is vertical instead of horizontal — wrong.
- (B) Horizontal diamond on top, tilted spade bottom-left, upright club bottom-right — matches exactly.

\boxed{B}
